base_format.description: Base package format to read from (rpm|deb|tgz|slp|pkg). alien reads the input package type from its filename extension, but this can be used to force interpretation.

target_formats.description: List of output formats to generate. Valid values: deb, rpm, tgz, slp, pkg. If omitted but install is true, defaults to ['deb'].

install.description: Whether to automatically install each generated package after conversion and remove the input package file.

scripts.description: Whether to convert package maintainer scripts (preinst, postinst, prerm, postrm). Note: review scripts manually before using.

patch_file.description: Explicit patch file path to use during deb generation, overriding automatic lookup in /var/lib/alien. Has no effect unless generating a deb.

no_patch.description: Disable all patching when building a deb package.

keep_version.description: Do not increment the minor version number when converting packages. By default, alien adds 1 to the minor version.

bump_version.description: Increment the converted package version by this number instead of the default +1 (requires keep_version=false).

target_arch.description: Force the architecture string for the generated package (e.g., 'amd64', 'i386', 'all').

description.description: Package description (only effective when converting from tgz, which lacks descriptions).

version.description: Package version (only effective when converting from tgz, which may lack version info).

fixperms.description: Sanitize file owners and permissions during deb generation. May break some packages; defaults to off.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode: print commands as they are executed.

very_verbose.description: Very verbose mode: also print output of each executed command.

generate_only.description: Generate a temporary build directory but do not build the package. Useful for manual modification before building.

single_directory.description: Generate a single directory without the .orig subdirectory (useful when disk space is constrained and building a deb).

test_package.description: Run lintian (if installed) to test generated deb packages. Currently deb-only.

email.description: Email address to embed in generated Debian packages. Overrides environment variable EMAIL.

input_files.description: List of input package files to convert. Required. Supported extensions: .rpm, .deb, .tgz, .slp, .pkg.
